name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=battle core, descriptor='last_hit_or_miss_flag' which correctly conveys both purpose and the flag data-type). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Accurately reflects semantics (last physical-attack hit/miss result, 0=HIT,1=MISS).
purpose: Last physical-attack hit/miss result flag shared between the combat damage calculator and the hit-animation routine. Encoding: 0 = HIT, 1 = MISS.
logic_summary: Single-byte flag in .object2 BSS. fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation sets it to 1 (MISS) at entry, then to 0 (HIT) when the to-hit roll (rng%100 < attacker_DX - defender_DX) succeeds. fd2_animate_attack_hit_sequence reads it 3 times: if !=0 it forces the miss whoosh SFX (id 4) instead of the per-step SFX, and on step 0/step 1 it uses (flag==0) as 'not_miss' to gate whether the attacker's attack pose is painted (a miss plays no pose). Always written before any read in a given attack, so the BSS zero-init carries no runtime semantics.
element_semantics: Scalar flag byte: 0 = HIT, 1 = MISS. Accessed byte-width (CMP byte ptr at 0x1ea32/0x1eac5, MOVZX byte ptr at 0x1eada => treated unsigned).
notes: src comment block (battle.c lines 1036-1046) was already accurate, precise and ASCII-clean (the 'hit\miss' seen in a Grep render is a display artifact; file content is 'hit/miss'), so no src Edit was made -> only the shard is staged for this symbol's commit. Ghidra plate at 0x53C6B was empty (null) and was created from the src conclusions; FD2.LE saved. xrefs: WRITE x2 from fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation (0x1ecda set=1, 0x1eedd set=0), READ x3 from fd2_animate_attack_hit_sequence (0x1ea32, 0x1eac5, 0x1eada).
